class: A builder reports done without formatting the frontend files it touched or regenerating a generated artefact its change makes stale (the OpenAPI file after a model change), so the orchestrator's gate fails on something the builder could have fixed in a minute.
mechanism: The builder handover has no checklist line for prettier or OpenAPI regeneration, and the builder's own gate run was skipped or ran on an older tree; the first run that catches it is the orchestrator's gate, 10 min later.

first_seen.evidence: gate result lines: 'GATE FAIL frontend-format' (32f, prettier not run; the 32f builder also skipped gate.py) and 'GATE FAIL openapi-drift' (30b2, OpenAPI not regenerated): two red gates.

fix: ADR-188 (2): builder handover = prettier on touched frontend files + OpenAPI regenerate when a model changed + hard stop at budget. The line is in docs/process/builder-brief.md and chunk-session-prompts.md rule 12. ADR-178 tracker row 16.

detection.note: Caught at the gate, not at handover: both occurrences were stopped by these two gate steps before CI, at the cost of a failed gate run each.
